prompt: Show me the current wallet status, and tell me when the session key needs to be re-minted.
expected_output: Calls status_snapshot(state) which returns chain/address/balance/auth (and session fields if mainnet). Explains the two triggers: <24h to expiry OR <10% spend remaining.

assertions.name: shows_wallet_status
assertions.description: Output must mention the status fields

assertions.name: session_needs_renewal
assertions.description: Output must reference the session_needs_renewal logic

assertions.name: two_triggers_explained
assertions.description: Output must explain both the expiry and spend triggers

assertions.name: human_only_remint
assertions.description: Output must say the cold-wallet signature is required for re-mint
